title: SentenceExerciseImport
description: Array of sentence exercises importable into one sentence collection (Sentences → Manage sentence collections → ⬆ on a collection). The collection decides the sentences' language. Three kinds: "fill_blank" (pick the missing word for one or two blanks), "jumble" (put scrambled words in order) and "transform" (rewrite the sentence: tense, negative, question, active/passive). Import the same "id" again to update an exercise; an entry with the same kind and sentence but no matching id is skipped as a duplicate. A collection holds at most 2000 exercises.

id.description: Optional stable id, e.g. 'b1-fill-001'. Re-importing an exercise with the same id updates it.

sentence.description: fill_blank: the sentence with each blank written as ___ (three underscores), one or two blanks. jumble: the correct sentence; its words are shuffled into tiles (split on spaces; a final . ? ! stays fixed at the end). transform: the sentence the user starts from.

answers.description: fill_blank: exactly one word per blank, in order (each at most 60 characters). transform: the accepted results, best first (1–10, each at most 300 characters); the closest one is used to grade the answer and shown as the correction.

distractors.description: Wrong words offered next to the right ones. fill_blank: required, at least one. jumble: optional; added only when the user turns on "Extra words". A distractor equal to an answer (or to a word of the sentence) is ignored.

alternatives.description: jumble only: other correct word orders. Each must use exactly the same words as "sentence" (case aside), e.g. 'Morgen gehe ich ins Kino.' for 'Ich gehe morgen ins Kino.'.

task.description: transform only, required: what to turn the sentence into. German: present = Präsens, simple_past = Präteritum, present_perfect = Perfekt, past_perfect = Plusquamperfekt, future = Futur I, future_perfect = Futur II. English: present simple, past simple, present perfect, past perfect, will-future, future perfect.

translations.description: Translation of the complete (correct) sentence, keyed by language code. Shown with the hint and after answering.

hint.description: Optional short hint in any language, shown when the user asks for it, e.g. 'Dativ nach "mit"'.

tags.description: Grammar topics, e.g. 'dative', 'word-order', 'perfect'. The app learns which topics you score low on and offers their sentences more often.
